q: The notion of a sofic shift (image of an SFT under a factor map) is strictly more general than SFT. The key example showing the difference is:
opts: The even shift (sequences where between any two 1s there are an even number of 0s), which is sofic but not an SFT
exp: The even shift: S = {x ∈ {0,1}^ℤ : every run of 0s between 1s has even length}. It is sofic (factor of an SFT via a 2-symbol labeling) but not an SFT—no finite list of forbidden words characterises it (arbitrarily long 'even run' conditions are needed).
